name: animated-shiny-text
blurb: A bright shimmer sweeps across text from left to right, looping continuously.
description: Renders text with a moving highlight shine effect using CSS background-position animation. The shimmer width is configurable. Light effect works on both light and dark themes.
use_when: Inline or block text wants a subtle, elegant shine effect that doesn't require JavaScript.
avoid_when: When text must remain completely static or when shimmer width needs dynamic adjustment per character.
a11y: Text is readable; shimmer is purely visual via CSS background-clip.
